Those within the blast must make a Fortitude save or take 1d4 cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d4) and be entangled and unable to move until they free themselves. A successful saving throw halves this damage and prevents the entangled condition and reduction in speed.

On their turn, a creature hindered by the ice may attempt to break free as a move action, making a Strength or Escape Artist check against the DC of the spell. The area of the cone is considered a slippery surface. A creature attempting to traverse the area at more than half speed must make a DC 15 Acrobatics check at the start of the movement or when they first enter the affected area. Failure causes the creature to fall prone at that point. Running or charging in the area increases the DC by 5. A creature that succeeds on this check by 5 or more may choose to increase their speed for the movement by 10 feet by sliding but are considered flat?footed until the beginning of their next turn. Creatures with class abilities that prevent them from being caught flat-footed are not flat-footed from this sliding.
spell-black-hole:
Creatures and objects within the spell's radius cannot take a move action, 5-foot step, or run, and are pulled to a single point in the center of the spell's area. Each creature that enters or begins its turn in the spell's area must save until it is crushed in the center of the hole or it escapes the radius. Anyone who fails takes 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage, and moves 5 feet closer to the center of the spell's area. On a successful save, a creature can move 5 feet away from the spell's center as a move action.

A creature that begins its turn at the spell's center and fails the save takes double damage from the spell. A creature that dies while within the spell's area is crushed by the black hole's gravity and vanishes, utterly destroyed in the void.

Creatures in the affected area add their size bonus or penalty to CMD on saves against black hole. Each creature that enters or begins its turn in the black hole must save until it is crushed in the center of the hole or it escapes the radius. The black hole distorts space so that creatures inside the area of effect can move through or share spaces without penalty All ranged attack rolls into the black hole suffer a –10 penalty to hit. Ranged attack rolls out of the black hole with corporeal weapons miss automatically.
spell-black-hole-3pp-orphaned-bookworm-p:
You create a dark void rift from the dark tapestry in a 40-foot radius sphere. The area is supernaturally dark as if by the deeper darkness spell and no sound can be heard within as per the silence spell. Movement through the radius of the sphere is difficult terrain.

Any creature that enters the area or begins their turn within the sphere must make a Fortitude save or take 8d6 force damage and be moved 5 feet toward the center of the sphere. A successful save halves this damage and prevents the movement. If the creature is unable to move toward the center due to an obstruction or the spaces already being occupied, the creature doe not move. A creature at the center of the sphere takes 8d10 force damage instead of 8d6. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this spell is disintegrated into a fine gray dust.
spell-blanket-of-stars:
A flowing cloak of darkness broken by points of light, like the lights of distant stars, enshrouds you. You gain a +2 bonus to Stealth checks in dark areas. While outside at night, you are invisible if you have not moved during the turn. If you have moved, you are visible but have 20% concealment. This concealment and invisibility is not considered mind-affecting. Attacking or taking hostile actions does not break the invisibility.

Gazing at the pattern of stars can be disorienting. Any creature that ends their turn adjacent to you must make a Will save or be confused and dazzled for 1 round. On a successful saving throw, the creature is dazzled for 1 round.
spell-borrowed-knowledge: You draw upon the knowledge of your ancestors or other spirits of the past. Choose one skill. For the duration you gain an insight bonus on the skill equal to your caster level and are considered trained in the skill. You cannot have multiple instances of this spell active at once.
spell-cast-into-time: You release a wave of temporal energy that send creatures within the area violently tumbling through time, scarring their thoughts and bodies with the time and objects flowing around them. Although the journey can feel like it lasts for minutes or even days, the targets reappear at the beginning of your next turn. Witnessing the chaotic flow of time and striking objects from different times deals 1d8 damage per caster level (max 15d8) to the affected creatures. Half of the damage is non-magical bludgeoning and half of the damage is mental trauma and not subject to resistance or damage reduction. However, if a creature is immune to mind-affecting effects, they are immune to the mental-half of the damage. The creature reappears in the square they left and are sickened for 1 round. If the square is occupied at that time, it instead appears in the nearest empty space, chosen by the GM. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage, negates the sickened condition and the creature reappears at the beginning of their turn instead of the beginning of your next turn.
spell-caustic-brew: You shoot out a stream of acid coating all targets in a 30-foot line. All creatures must succeed at a Reflex save or be covered in acid and take 1d4 acid damage at the beginning of their turn. At the end of each of their turns, the affected creature can attempt a Reflex save to end the effect or spend a standard action to scrape off the acid.
spell-celestial-rebuke: You pull fire from the heavens to strike any who would deign to attack you. When activated, the creature that targeted you with an attack or offensive ability or spell is dealt 1d4 damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Half of the damage dealt is fire damage and the other half is divine damage and is not subject to energy resistance or immunity.
spell-chromatic-armor:
You wrap the target in armor made from sheets of colored light. The armor sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for the next 20 feet. Whenever an adjacent creature attacks the target or attacks the target with a melee natural weapon, the attacker must make a Will save at the end of its turn. On a failure, it is dazzled until the end of its next turn.

When you cast the spell, roll 1d8 twice on the table below to see the armor's colors (re-rolling any duplicates). Each color grants resistance equal to 5 against the indicated energy type. On a roll of 8, the armor matches the damage most recently taken, if there was none or the armor already has resistance to that type, roll again. This resistance increases by 5 every 4 caster levels after 7th, to a maximum of 20 at 19th. You can spend a standard action on your turn to adjust the colors affecting a target of this spell. A single creature can only benefit from one casting of chromatic armor at a time.
spell-chromatic-image: This spell operates as mirror image except you and the images shift in color. Whenever a foe destroys an image, they are dealt 1d6 plus your caster level in damage. Half of the damage is the damage type rolled on the table at the bottom of page 39, the other half is psychic damage caused by the flashing color that is not subject to resistance. However, if the target is immune to mind?affecting, they are immune to that half of the damage. Re-roll any results of 8 rolled on the table to determine the damage type.
spell-cloud-of-needles: This spell functions as lesser cloud of needles except it deals 2 piercing damage per round and the damage is considered magic for DR purposes. The damage is also considered silver or cold iron for DR purposes, chosen when the spell is cast.
spell-cloud-of-needles-greater: This spell functions as cloud of needles except it deals 3 piercing damage per round and the damage is considered adamantine for DR purposes.
spell-cloud-of-needles-lesser: You conjure a multitude of needles which pierce the flesh of the target creature dealing 1 piercing damage per round at the beginning of their turn. They may make a Fortitude save to negate the damage for the round. A critical failure on this saving throw doubles the damage for the round while a critical success ends the spell altogether. The piercing damage dealt is physical and is subject to DR. The needles disappear when the duration expires.
spell-cloud-of-needles-mass: This spell functions as cloud of needles except it affects multiple targets.
spell-cloud-of-needles-mass-greater: This spell functions as greater cloud of needles except it affects multiple targets.
spell-cloud-of-needles-mass-lesser: This spell functions as lesser cloud of needles except it affects multiple targets and the damage is considered magical for DR purposes.
spell-cloud-of-razors: This spell functions as lesser cloud of razors except it deals 2 slashing damage per round and the damage is considered magic for DR purposes. The damage is also considered silver or cold iron for DR purposes, chosen when the spell is cast.
spell-cloud-of-razors-greater: This spell functions as cloud of razors except it deals 3 slashing damage per round and the damage is considered adamantine for DR purposes.
spell-cloud-of-razors-lesser: You conjure a multitude of razors that cut the flesh of the target creature dealing 1 slashing damage per round at the beginning of their turn. They may make a Fortitude save to negate the damage for the round. A critical failure on this saving throw doubles the damage for the round while a critical success ends the spell altogether. The slashing damage dealt is physical and is subject to DR. The razors disappear when the duration expires.
spell-cloud-of-razors-mass: This spell functions as cloud of razors except it affects multiple targets.
spell-cloud-of-razors-mass-lesser: This spell functions as lesser cloud of razors except it affects multiple targets and the damage is considered magical for DR purposes.
spell-cloud-of-shards:
You utter the words of the spell releasing the bit of glass, creating an immovable cloud of spinning force shards in a 5-foot-cube. Any creature entering the area or beginning their turn in the area takes 1d6 points of magical slashing damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), with a Reflex save for half damage.

A cloud ofshards provides cover (+4 bonus to AC, +2 bonus on Reflex saves) against attacks made through it.
spell-comfort-food: This spell acts as purify food and drink except that it also makes the food exceptionally good and instills hope and well-being in those that eat it. The food keeps its magic charge for 1 hour. Consuming the food takes 10 minutes and the beneficial effects kick in once the 10 minutes has elapsed. If the eating is interrupted, the spell is not ruined as long as the food is consumed within the 1 hour of its charge. The food grants a +1 morale bonus on initiative, attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks and damage rolls for 10 minutes per caster level. Additionally, if the subject is under the effect of a despair effect (with the exception of curses) when the food consumption is completed, they get an immediate saving throw against the effect with the new bonus.
spell-conviction: You utter a prayer and bolster the mental, physical and spiritual strength of the target. They gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws. The bonus increases by +1 for every 6 caster levels you possess, to a maximum of +5 at 18th level.
spell-conviction-communal: This spell functions like conviction except you divide the duration in 1-minute intervals among the creatures touched.
spell-cowardice:
This spell imbues a single creature with a sense of deep seated despair and cowardice. On a failed save, the target of the spell is despairing.

Mythic The creature is given the despairing condition.

Enemies adjacent to the target take a -4 penalty on saves against fear.

Augmented (3rd): If you expend two uses of mythic power, the target is staggered (as if by the slow spell). The target is staggered for a number of rounds equal to your tier.
spell-cowardice-greater: This spell acts as cowardice, except on a failed save, the target becomes hopeless.
spell-cowardice-lesser: This spell acts as cowardice, except on a failed save the target becomes doubting.
spell-crisis-of-faith: You utter words that shake the target's faith in their beliefs or their deity. The mental turmoil deals 1d6/caster level damage (maximum 10d6). If the target is able to cast divine spells, they instead take 1d8/caster level (maximum 10d8) damage and must make concentration checks to cast their divine spells for 1 round as if needing to cast defensively. A successful Will save halves this damage and negates the need for concentration checks if applicable.
spell-crown-of-stars:
You create 7 glowing motes of light that orbit your head until the spell ends. If at least 4 motes remain, you shed light as a torch, otherwise you shed light as a candle. The color and shape of the lights reflects the nature of the caster.

As a swift action you may send one of your motes of light at a target. If you succeed at a ranged touch attack, the mote deals 1d8 damage per 3 caster levels. This damage increases to d12s against undead.
spell-crushing-despair-modified-for-effe: An invisible cone of despair causes great sadness in the subjects. Each affected creature is subject to the despairing condition.
spell-crushing-despair-greater: This spell acts as the spell crushing despair (the modified version from this book) except as noted above and imposes the hopeless condition on the subjects.
spell-crushing-despair-lesser: This spell acts as the spell crushing despair (the modified version from this book) except as noted above and imposes the doubting condition on the subjects.
spell-crushing-pressure: This spell places a sheath of water around the torso of the target creature. Its pressure deals 1d6 points of damage to the target the first round. It deals an additional 1d6 points of damage each round after that (i.e. on the fourth round you deal 4d6). The target cannot cast spells with verbal components while constricted by this sheath. A successful save each round halves the damage and allows a spellcasting target creature to cast spells with verbal components. Creatures that are normally immune to pressure, such as those that dwell on the ocean floor, gain a +4 bonus to their save.
spell-crushing-pressure-3pp-orphaned-boo: This spell functions as lesser crushing pressure except it deals 2 bludgeoning damage per round and the damage is no longer subject to DR.
spell-crushing-pressure-greater: This spell functions as crushing pressure except it deals 3 piercing damage per round.
spell-crushing-pressure-lesser: You change the pressure of the air around the target causing it to painfully press in upon their body, dealing 1 bludgeoning damage per round at the beginning of their turn. They may make a Fortitude save to negate the damage for the round. This bludgeoning damage is physical and is subject to DR but is considered magic for DR purposes.
spell-crushing-pressure-mass: This spell functions as crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
spell-crushing-pressure-mass-greater: This spell functions as greater crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
spell-crushing-pressure-mass-lesser: This spell functions as lesser crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
spell-cure-grievous-wounds: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 5d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +25). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply Spell Resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.
spell-cure-grievous-wounds-3pp-orphaned-: This spell functions like mass word of light healing except that it heals 5d4 + 1 per two caster levels to all creatures (maximum +22).
spell-cure-grievous-wounds-mass: This spell functions like mass cure light wounds except that it cures 5d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +45).
spell-curse-of-melancholy:
This spell inflicts a curse upon the target where everything seems impossible and hope is all but lost.

While under the effects of this curse, the target does not benefit from any morale bonus and they are subject to the doubting condition. Additionally, the save penalty the target suffers from the doubting condition is increased to -4 vs. fear and despair effects.

The curse bestowed by this spell cannot be dispelled, but it can be removed with a break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, remove curse, or wish spell.

Curse of melancholy can counter remove curse.
spell-danger-ahead:
Requirement Rabbit-kin.

A Rabbit-kin may focus his vision and grant himself a three second glimpse into the near future. A Rabbit-kin who casts Danger Ahead sees herself engaged in a possible challenge or encounter that will occur in the next 24 hours (as revealed by the GM). As the future is always in flux, the events shown by Danger Ahead may not always occur the way the Rabbit-kin saw it, but the knowledge gained can help them prepare or make decisions when the event occurs.
spell-darklight: This spell functions as the spell darkness except that you and one ally per level can see through the area of darkness as if it were not active.
spell-darkspeech: Darkspeech You learn a smattering of the ancient form of abyssal, which holds power through simple speech. Prerequisite(s) Int 13, Character level 5th. Benefit(s) You gain a +1 bonus against all spells with the evil descriptor and a verbal component and increase the save DC of evil spells you cast with a verbal component by +1. In addition, you may utter a curse targeted at a single creature within 30 feet as a standard action. The target must make a Will save with a DC of 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Intelligence modifier or be staggered for 1d4 rounds. Using this power is taxing and deals 1 Wisdom damage to you. This is a mind affecting, supernatural effect.
spell-dawns-light: Create an area of radiant dawn in a 40-foot-high cylinder with a 30-foot radius. For the purposes of creatures harmed by sunlight, this is considered daylight. The light level is considered bright within the cylinder and for 30 feet outside and provides dim light out 60 further feet. Each creature beginning their turn within the area of sunlight or entering within must make a Fortitude save or take 1d6 positive energy damage/3 caster levels and be blinded until the beginning of their next turn. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and reduces the blinded to dazzled until the beginning of their next turn. Creatures from the positive energy plane or made of light, like lurkers in light, are immune to the effects of this spell.
spell-death-ward-mass: This spell functions like death ward, except as noted above.
spell-deeper-darklight: This spell functions as the spell deeper darkness except that you and one ally per level can see through the area of darkness as if it were not active.
spell-deific-bolt: You launch a bolt of divine energy at your target. The nature of the divine bolt varies depending upon the deity or creed that grants you your powers. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the bolt to deal damage to the target. The bolt deals 1d6 damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels (max 5d6). Additionally, if hit, the target is limned in the energy imposing a -5 penalty on Stealth checks and a -1 penalty to AC for 1 round. The spell gains the alignment descriptor corresponding to your deity's or creed's alignment.
spell-deific-wrath: You call upon the power of your deity or faith and fill in an area with its glory. You cause an area within be filled with various boons from your deity. Each effect has an amount of space within the area that can be affected and the exact manifestation of each effect is dependent upon the deity or faith creating it. SR is checked per effect and only one effect may be in any particular square.
spell-despoiling-utterance:
The caster draws forth power from ancient abyssal curses and foul dark secrets. The utterance is so damning that it harms the very soul of the creature that hears it. The despoiling utterance causes one subject within range to take 1d4 points of Charisma drain. The caster gains 5 temporary hit points for each point of drain inflicted by this spell.

These temporary hit points disappear after 1 hour.
spell-detect-weaponry:
You can detect the presence or absence of manufactured weapons within the area of effect.

The spell detects improvised weapons only if the wielder is actively intending to use them as weapons. The amount of information revealed by this spell depends on how long you concentrate on the spell within an area.

This spell does not reveal the exact kind of weapon, nor if the weapon is magical in any way. Weapons affected by spells or effects that hide their presence such as nondetection are not detected by this spell.

Each round, you can detect within a new area as the spell. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it.
spell-devilsight:
The target gains the same visual power of a devil.

They can see in darkness, and also in magical darkness, with a range of 30 feet. This vision, unlike darkvision, is in color.
spell-dimension-door-greater: This spell functions like dimension door, except as noted above and that you can transfer yourself and the targets once per round, up to the spell's range, as a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
spell-disheartening-darkness: This spell acts as the spell darkness except that any who enter the affected area must make a Will save or be afflicted with the doubting condition. If the creature has spell resistance, it applies to the condition. If a creature leaves the area of darkness, they are no longer affected by the doubting condition. However, any creature, including those who have left the area, who enter the radius of darkness are subject to making the Will save.
spell-disrupt-undead-greater: This spells acts as disrupt undead except that the ray deals 1d8 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 10d8. If the ray is enough to destroy the first target it may be redirected to a second target within 15 ft. of the original target. You must succeed at a ranged touch against the second target to affect it. If the second ray hits, the second target takes the excess damage that went over the remaining hp of the first target.
spell-dissonant-melody: You intone a discordant melody that only one creature within range can hear. The tone fills the target's mind with pain and drives them away from you. The target takes 1d4 damage/level (maximum 5d4), deafened, and on their turn must move up to their movement speed away, or as far as they can safely move. A successful Will save halves the damage and negates the requirement to move on their turn and the deafening. Creatures immune to mind-affecting spells are immune to the damage inflicted by this spell.
spell-divine-light: This spell functions like the lesser divine light spell except the damage dealt is 1d4/level (maximum 5d4) to living creatures, or 1d6/level (maximum 5d6) to undead creatures.
spell-divine-light-lesser: You envelop the target a shining radiance dealing 1d3 positive energy damage to the target if they are a living creature, or 1d6 positive energy damage if the creature is undead. This has no effect on constructs or objects. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
spell-draw-moisture: You draw water out of an object to clean up spills or quickly dry a soaked object, like clothing, wood floors or a precious document. The object is returned to a pre-wet state as long as it was soaked within the last hour. The spell dries an object weighing up to 5 lbs. The water collects into a floating globule floating in your hand. You can direct the globule into a receptacle while casting the spell or it splashes onto the ground. You can use repeated castings of this spell to dry larger objects. You can also use this spells to draw moisture in humid environments, thought you can only condense about 2 cups of water before depleting the ambient moisture in the area.
spell-duelists-spellward:
When you cast this spell you gesture a ward of protection and toss the material component in the air, the glass eye then shatters harmlessly and a halo of shimmering glass dust floats above your head.

While a duelist's spellward lasts you may counterspell as an immediate action without having previously readied an action to do so and you gain a +4 insight bonus to Spellcraft checks to identify spells being cast. The first time you successfully counter a spell while under the effects of duelist's spellward it ends, granting you a +1 bonus to caster level for the next spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
spell-eclipse-burst:
You create a globe of vile cold that explodes in the area dealing 1d8 cold damage per 3 caster levels (maximum 6d8) and 1d8 negative energy damage per 3 caster levels (maximum 6d8). A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Additionally, the burst of darkness snuffs out any non-magical light sources (except daylight) and dispels any spell of 5th level or lower with the light descriptor active in the area as if using a targeted dispel magic spell.
spell-electric-charge: This spell functions as lesser electric charge except it deals 2 electricity damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are staggered until the beginning of their next turn.
spell-electric-charge-greater: This spell functions as electric charge except it deals 3 electricity damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are stunned for until the beginning of their next turn.
spell-electric-charge-mass: This spell functions as electric charge except it affects multiple targets.
spell-electric-charge-mass-greater: This spell functions as greater electric charge except it affects multiple targets.
spell-electric-charge-mass-lesser: This spell functions as lesser electric charge except it affects multiple targets.
spell-electric-connection: You form an electrical arc between you and the target dealing 1d4 electricity damage. When taking a move action to maintain the spell, the target takes an additional 1d4 electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves the damage taken that round. If the target leaves the range, or breaks line-of-effect from you, the spell ends. If when maintaining the spell, there is another creature in the line-of-effect between you and the target, that creature is affected by the spell instead of the target, the closest creature on the line is affected.
spell-electrical-charge-lesser: You charge the target's body with electricity, dealing 1 electricity damage to them at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save negates the damage for the round. This spell counters a spell of equal or lower level and is countered by a spell of equal or higher level from the vitriol group of spells. If the target is affected by an earth or acid descriptor spell of the same spell level or higher, this spell ends.
spell-elemental-investiture:
You wreath you body in elemental power, choosing between earth, fire, ice, or wind when the spell is cast. The spell gains the descriptor of the element chosen.

If you choose earth you gain the following:

If you choose fire you gain the following:

If you choose ice you gain the following:

If you choose wind you gain the following:
spell-embers-charge: This spell functions as lesser embers except it deals 2 fire damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are sickened until the beginning of their next turn.
spell-embers-greater: This spell functions as embers except it deals 3 fire damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are nauseated for until the beginning of their next turn.
spell-embers-lesser: You cover the target creature with burning embers, dealing 1 fire damage to them at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save negates the damage for the round. This spell counters a spell of of equal or lower level and is countered by a spell of equal or higher level from the rime group of spells. If the target is affected by a cold or water descriptor spell of the same spell level or higher, this spell ends.
spell-embers-mass-lesser: This spell functions as lesser embers except it affects multiple targets.
spell-encouragement: You complete the spell and give a call of encouragement to your allies. All allies may immediately make a save against one ongoing mind-affecting effect of the ally's choosing (with the exception of curses). If the effect is a despair effect, the subject gains a +4 morale bonus on this save. This spell cannot be used on characters under a charm effect or under dominate person or similar spell.
spell-enhance-emotions: This spell exacerbates any emotions the targets may be feeling. Any creature caught in the area may make a Will save to negate the effects. However, any creature may choose to forgo the Will save. An affected creature has any bonus (usually morale) or penalty created by an emotion or fear effect doubled while under the effects of this spell. This includes effects that affect the creature after they are subject to this spell.
spell-entropic-cut:
You tear a hole in reality pulling energy from a realm of endless madness and form it into a black blade the width of a needle. You slice through your opponents with the blade of entropy, causing wounds that are sickly and black. Each target takes 2d6 damage. A successful Fortitude halves this damage but it affects undead and constructs normally.

You may instead focus on a single target rather than multiple. If you target only one creature and it fails its save, the target is also staggered for a number of rounds equal to your caster level.
spell-expectation-of-failure: Each affected creature is filled with the potential for profound failure. If the creature is subject to a penalty from a fear or despair effect, the caster may discharge the spell to double the penalty on one roll made by the subject before the roll is made. Alternatively, the caster may discharge the spell to double the AC penalty (if applicable) against a single attack.
spell-explosive-pellet:
Requirement Owl-kin.

The Owl-kin coughs up the bones and fur of its previous meals, imbues it with explosive magic, and throws it at their enemy. If the Owl-kin succeeds on a ranged tough attack the target takes 1d4/level bludgeoning damage (Max 10d4). Everyone within a 10-foot-radius of the target (including the target) takes 1d6/2 levels fire damage (Max 10d6). Fire damage occurs even if the ranged touch attack misses, but always allows anyone effected a Reflex save for half damage.
spell-falling-sky:
You manipulate the pressure of the air in an area an bring it down like a massive weight down to the ground. All flying creatures in the area descend to the bottom of the spell's area, taking double the normal fall damage if it results in hitting the ground or another hard surface. If they do not strike a surface within the spell's area, they instead take normal fall damage instead of double due to the concussive movement downward.

Creatures within the spells area are knocked prone and are stunned for 1 round, then staggered for 1d4 rounds thereafter. On a successful Fortitude save, the affected creatures are instead knocked prone and staggered for 1d4 rounds.
spell-forcedisk:
You throw a spinning disk of force at a target that has the possibility of ricocheting to additional targets. You must make a ranged touch attack. If the attack hits, the target is dealt 3d6 force damage and the disk ricochets to another target within 15 feet of the initial target. The secondary target must also be hit with a ranged touch attack and if hit, is dealt 2d6 force damage. This continues until you reach your maximum number of secondary targets (1 per 2 caster levels, max 5), run out of eligible targets or voluntarily end the spell. A creature may only be damaged by this spell once.

The disk is subject to spell resistance and if you fail the caster level check to overcome spell resistance, the spell ends.

The exact form, color and nature of the force disk is mutable and determined by the caster of the spell. The form does not change the damage type of the spell.
spell-frigid-flurry:
You complete the spell by breathing out a cold breath that freezes the ambient moisture in the air into jagged shards. The flurry deals 1d6 damage per caster level (max 20d6) half of which is cold damage and the other half is slashing damage that is treated as magical for DR purposes. Allies within the line are left unaffected and enemies within the line may make a Reflex save to halve the damage.

Additionally the cold snap carries you to any point along the line of affect if you choose to move and this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This spell and the movement cannot pass through solid barriers.
spell-frigid-maw:
Your or your animal companion's bite attack deals an additional 1d4 points of cold damage, and the target is staggered for 1 round per 2 caster levels. A successful Fortitude save reduces the stagger effect to a -10 penalty to speed (minimum 0). The staggered effect and reduction in speed doesn't stack from multiple attacks, but the duration resets if a newer bite would cause the ongoing damage to last longer or the effect would increase to staggered.

The cold does not harm you or the animal companion.
spell-gale-blast: You focus and release a burst of air, shunting your enemies away from you. Each creature within 5 feet of you takes 1d3 non-magical bludgeoning damage and is pushed directly away from you 5 feet. Any creature that is a size category larger than you is unaffected. A successful Fortitude save reduces the bludgeoning damage to 1 and the creature is not pushed back. If the pushing back would put the creature in immense danger, like shunting them off a cliff, they gain a + 5 bonus on the save.
spell-glimpse-eternity: You call forth ancient memories of the multiverse and channel that power into a target. Unless they succeed at a Will saving throw they experience thousands of years of memories in the blink of an eye dealing 15d6 nonlethal damage and 1d6 Intelligence drain. If your target is knocked unconscious by this damage they enter a catatonic slumber for 24 hours.
spell-good-hope-greater: This spell acts as the spell good hope except as noted above and grants a +4 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls and temporary hit points equal to your caster level.
spell-good-hope-lesser: This spell acts as the spell good hope except as noted above and grants a +1 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls.
spell-healing-touch-greater: This spell functions as lesser healing touch except that the amount healed is 1d8 + 1 per caster level (max +15).
spell-healing-touch-lesser:
You hold your touch on the target and their wounds begin to mend. Each round that you touch a target you heal them 1d2 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum +2).

This spell cannot be used to harm undead. Each round while concentrating on the spell, you may change who you are touching for this spell.
spell-heroism-lesser: This spell acts as the spell heroism, The target gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.
spell-hopeless-shadow: This spell acts as the spell disheartening darkness except it creates a darkness effect as per the deeper darkness spell and imposes the despairing condition.
spell-icelance:
You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the target with the icelance. If the attack hits, you deal 1d6 damage per level (maximum 10d6).

Half of the damage is piercing, the other half is cold damage. Additionally, the target must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. After striking or missing its target, the icelance shatters.
spell-icy-simulacrum:
You create a powerful freezing rain on the target that deals 2d6 cold damage, Reflex save for half. If the target fails the Reflex save, they are frozen in place, covered with a thick sheet of ice for 1 round. The target is paralyzed and may only take mental actions but may make a DC 25 Strength or Escape Artist check to free themselves as a full-round action. Allies may also attempt to break the target free by making the Strength check themselves or attempting to break the ice which is treated as having 30 hp and 5 hardness.

If the target remains frozen for 1 round, the target is freed but the ice turns into a moving copy of the target under your control. The simulacrum lasts for 1 round per level.

The copy has none of the spellcasting, spell-like abilities, supernatural abilities, class abilities or feats of the target, though it is automatically proficient with any weapon it is created with. It has an attack bonus equal to your base attack bonus plus your spellcasting modifier. Giving direction to the simulacrum is a move action that may be performed mentally. If given no orders, the simulacrum continues with its previous orders or attacks the original target of the spell.

The simulacrum deals damage and attacks using a copy of the weapon used by the target except it has none of the magical properties of the weapon. The weapon instead deals half of the normal physical damage and half cold damage, is considered magical for DR purposes and adds your spellcasting modifier to damage (though is not multiplied for two-handed). If the simulacrum has no weapon (or natural weapon), is disarmed or is ordered to drop its copy weapon, it has a slam attack that deals 1d6 damage, half of which is bludgeoning, half is cold damage.

The simulacrum has hit points equal to the higher of half the total of the original target or 30, AC equal to 10 + your spellcasting modifier and hardness 5. If the simulacrum is destroyed, the spell ends.
spell-invisibility-superior:
This spells acts as greater invisibility except that you create no sound, footprints and have no smell unless you wish to. Additionally, your invisibility is not thwarted by spells like invisibility purge, glitterdust, or faerie fire or the blindsense ability.

However, creatures affected by true seeing or blindsight can still detect the subject of the spell.
spell-kinetic-jaunt: You charge your movements with energy and force giving you speed and agility. You gain the following benefits:
spell-mage-armor-greater:
This spell is identical to mage armor but the bonus of the armor has an initial bonus of +6 and gains a further +2 bonus every 5 levels beyond 5th to a maximum of +10 at 15th level.

This spell lists two different schools. The general rules regarding this issue are as follows:

This spell is built upon the standard mage armor spell. As a result the benefits of these spells do not stack with each other. If the spell caster casts another mage armor (or mage armor variant spell) while one is currently active, the new spell replaces the active spell and any effects from the previous spell are ended immediately. Any spell that grants a force-based armor bonus is considered a mage armor (or variant) spell for purposes of this restriction.
spell-magic-missile-storm-greater: This spell functions as lesser magic missile storm except it creates 1 force missile per caster level (to a maximum of 20 missiles) and the damage dealt per missile increases to 1d8+1 force damage.
spell-magic-missile-storm-lesser:
This spell functions as magic missile except the spell creates 1 force missile per caster level (to a maximum of 10 missiles) and each missile randomly targets enemies within the radius of the spell Also, each missile deals 1d6+1 force damage.

If there are more targets than missiles, only the closest targets to the center of the radius are affected. These force missiles are considered magic missiles for the purposes of the shield spell or other items that absorb or negate magic missiles.
spell-magical-savant: You align your magical energies with those of an object. For the duration of the spell you gain a +4 insight bonus on Use Magic Device checks with that object. If you have 10 or more ranks in Use Magic Device, you can take 10 on Use Magic Device checks with the item, even if the situation wouldn t normally allow you to do so.
spell-magical-scrutiny: You designate a particular action when casting the spell. If the target of the spell performs the particular action during the spell's duration, you are instantly alerted regardless of distance as long as the target is on the same plane. When alerted, you are not given the details of when, where, how or why, but you know that the action was performed by the target.
spell-mark-of-implacable-hunting: You mark a target as your quarry. As long as the target is on the same plane, you know the distance and direction the creature is in relation to you. You also know if it is moving and if so, in what direction. You gain a + 10 bonus to Perception checks to notice the target if it is using Stealth or recognize it if it is using Disguise. If the target succeeds on their saving throw, this spell instead acts as the spell tracking mark except its duration is 1 hour per level.
spell-mental-overload:
You touch the target and send a jolt of psychic information flooding into their mind.

You must succeed at a melee touch attack to affect the target. If successful, the target takes 1d8 damage per caster level (max 20d8) and the target is staggered for 1 minute. A successful Fortitude save negates the staggered condition and halves the damage.
spell-mischief:
You fill the area with whimsical magic, the nature of the burst depends upon the caster.

Roll on Table: Random Mishaps each round to determine the effect upon any creatures in the area. Each round after the first, you can move the area of the spell 10 feet before you determine the effect. The center of the area must remain within close range or the spell ends prematurely.
spell-moonburst:
You create an explosive globe of moonlight in the area, dealing 1d6 cold damage per level (maximum 20d6) to all creatures in the area. If the affected creature is undead or has DR that is bypassed by silver, this spell instead deals 1d8 untyped damage per class level (maximum 20d8). A successful Fortitude save halves the damage.

If there is a darkness or deeper darkness spell or similar effect within the radius, it is dispelled.
spell-mystic-tattoo: Mystic Tattoo You inscribe your spell power into your skin. Prerequisite(s) Spell Focus, Elemental Focus or other feat that increases the DCs of spells cast. Benefit(s) You can spend 100 gp per bonus to apply your bonus to spell DCs from feats to your caster level checks. This creates a tattoo of your choosing that exemplifies the kind of spells being augmented in this way. Each tattoo inscribed affects spells from one feat type. So, if you have Spell Focus ( evocation ) and Elemental Focus (fire), you could get a burning skeleton tattoo to improve the caster level check bonus to your fire spells, not fire spells and evocation spells even if the spell is an evocation -fire spell. You can get a second tattoo of mystic runes to also apply the evocation bonus later.
spell-nostalgia:
You fill the target's head with visions of good events and happy memories that leave them stuck in a bittersweet reverie. The target is dazed but may make a new save each round on their turn to break the effect.

This is a full round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
spell-ocular-overload:
Just as a creature is about to attack you or target you with a targeted spell or effect, you create a burst of jarring colors and patterns.

The creature must make a Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round, including for before the attack or spell/ability targeting, and dazzled for 1 minute thereafter. On a successful save, the target creature is dazzled for 1d6 rounds.
spell-otherworldly-acuity: You manifest the senses of a powerful outsider. You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet (or increase the range of your darkvision by 60 feet), and you can see in magical darkness as though it were regular darkness. In addition you can see invisible creatures and objects as well as creatures on the ethereal plane.
spell-pact-beyond-death:
When casting this spell on a creature subject to your geas spell, their geas now reaches beyond their mortal lifetime. If they die before the geas is fulfilled, they are reanimated as an undead 1 hour later per the spell create undead so that they may continue on their task. The exact type of undead is determined by the caster when this spell is cast.

Once the task is complete or the target is destroyed while in their undead form, this spell ends and the target returns to death. This change to undead does not remove any penalties incurred by the geas spell.

If the target is subject to a spell, effect, or set of circumstances that prevent them reanimating as an undead like the target dying in an area of the hallow spell, they are not reanimated. Spells like sanctify corpse only delay this reanimation.
spell-pact-beyond-death-greater: This spell acts as pact beyond death but instead of raising the target as per the spell create undead the target is raised as per the greater create undead spell.
spell-prescience:
You push your mind through the possible realities of the near future, determining what course of action the target is likely to take.

When the target takes an action during the duration, you may use an attack of opportunity to cause one of the effects below.

These effects are resolved after the target declares the action but before the action is resolved. The target may attempt a Reflex save to negate the spells effect for the round. If the spell's effect successfully interrupts the target's action, the action is still expended unless otherwise noted. Once a target has been successfully affected by this spell 3 times, the spell ends. You may only use each effect once per casting.
spell-prismatic-weapon:
You summon a weapon of glittering flashing colors of your choice, for which you are proficient. The weapon functions as a +1 version of the weapon created. In addition, as a swift action you can choose to discharge from your weapon one of the seven colors of the weapon, chosen from the list of colors shown under prismatic ray. Saves and spell resistance apply to the discharged effect as normal.

If the created weapon is a ranged weapon, it creates its own ammunition and the prismatic effect is discharged through the ammunition.

Once you use a color, it disappears from the weapon and you can t select that color again for the duration of the spell. Once all seven colors are used, the weapon vanishes.

d8 effect death; Sec effect 1 Con/rd.; cure 2 consecutive Fort saves) Insane as insanity spell (Will negates) Roll twice more, ignoring any "8" results Flesh to stone (Fort negates) Sent to another plane (Will negates) Beam Color Red Orange Yellow Green Indigo

No one else can use your prismatic weapon, though you need not wield it at all times. You can stow, drop or hand the weapon to another character. If you cast this spell a second time while the previous weapon is still active, the first weapon is replaced by the new one.
spell-reality-needles: You pull fine shards and needles of varying materials from other planes and realities and shoot them at your target. The target takes 1d4 piercing damage and takes 1 bleed damage for 3 rounds.
spell-reality-shift: You concentrate on the target watching and subtly shifting the myriad of realities surrounding them. Once per round, as an immediate action, you may move the target of the spell up to 10 feet in any direction to a spot they are willing and able to occupy. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity and may be made only between resolved actions not in the middle of the resolution of an action. While you concentrate on this spell you may switch your focus to another willing target.
spell-reality-warp:
You fold the boundaries of several realities around your target causing them to shift and change in unpredictable ways. These could be aging/de-aging of various portions of their bodies, parts of their bodies and organs swapped or misplaced, etc. If the target fails their Fortitude save (which can affect constructs and undead), roll on the table below and apply the resulting effect to the target. If the target is immune to the selected effect, roll a second time on the table and apply the second effect instead. If they are immune to the second effect, they are unaffected by the spell.

The duration of the effects are variable:

Except for baleful polymorph, a reality warp's effects cannot be dispelled, but they can be removed by break enchantment or any spell that removes the specific condition.
spell-remove-despair: This spell acts as the spell remove fear except is alleviates and protects against despair effects for the duration.
spell-restorative-sleep: You send out a protective barrier to the sleep of your targets. Restful sleep counters nightmare and any other harmful spell that targets the creature through their sleep or dreams if the spell is of equal or lower level. If the detrimental spell is successfully countered or dispelled, the caster of the spell is stunned for 1 minute per caster level. Additionally, the target of the spell gains 1d10 extra hit points of healing and gains the effects of lesser heroism for 1 hour per caster level after they awaken.
spell-restorative-sleep-3pp-zenith-games: Restorative sleep enhances the body's ability to heal itself. The next time the subject completes a full-night's rest, it heals itself of 1 point of temporary ability damage to one of its ability scores in addition to normal healing. Any significant interruption during the rest (such as being awoken) prevents any healing that night and ends the effect of this spell on the subject.
spell-scatter-scree:
You call toss the bit of scree up into the air summoning a rain of gravel in the designated areas. Any creatures in the area take 1d3 non-magical bludgeoning damage. A successful Reflex save reduces this damage to 1, creatures with evasion/improved evasion can negate this altogether. The ground in the affected areas become difficult terrain. A creature can use a standard action to clear the difficult terrain from a square.

If you cast the spell again, any previous difficult terrain you created disappears as you conjure the same pile of gravel.
spell-seismic-jaunt: This spell operates as the spell frigid flurry except it causes an explosion of rock and earth dealing magical bludgeoning damage and knocking the enemies in the area prone. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates the prone condition.
spell-shadow-siphon:
You open a rift to the shadow plane and attempt to divert some of the energy of an oncoming spell off the your current plane. You transform the spell into a quasi-real illusion.

The target of or part of the area of the spell must be within range. Creatures that would be damaged take only half as much damage.

To affect the spell, you must make a caster level check (1d20 + your caster level) and compare it to DC 9 + the target spell's caster level. On a failure the spell is too powerful for you to draw into the shadow plane.
spell-shield-greater:
When you cast this spell the material component breaks apart into a dozen pieces which float around you and protect you from harm. You gain all the benefits of shield except as follows. The bonus to AC increases to +6 and it can absorb up to 12 levels worth of ray spells directed at you.

When you are targeted by a ray you make a caster level check against it with a DC of 11 + the caster level of the ray. If you succeed the ray is deflected harmlessly to a side. You may instead choose to expend twice as many levels as needed to deflect the ray to redirect it back onto its original caster. You use the ray's original attack roll to determine if the ray strikes its new target.
spell-shifting-fortune:
You shift the fortunes of the target creature and give them to another. You may cast this spell on a target that had just succeeded on an attack roll, ability check, caster level check, skill check or saving throw. The target must make a Will save or be forced to reroll the check and use the lower roll.

You can then choose a different creature, including yourself to get the target's good fortune for 1 minute. If the benefiting creature rolls the same check as the original target, they can roll that check twice and take the higher result. Once this ability is used on a check, the spell ends.

A creature can only benefit from one casting of this spell at a time.
spell-shining-beacon:
Upon completion of this spell you are limned in a nimbus of light that shines like a torch, you gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma and are immune to fear and despair effects. Additionally you exude an aura of hope granting all allies within 30 feet a +1 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. The bonus to saving throws is increased to +4 vs. fear and despair effects.

Any ally under the effect of a despair or fear effect that enters the aura is granted an immediate save to end the effect with the bonus provided by the aura.
spell-skywrite: You can manipulate or form clouds that can into words. You can create up to 1 word per caster level. You must be able to see the area in which you are forming the words and the words can be dispersed by a strong wind, ending the spell early. At the end of the spell's duration the clouds disperse as if by a strong wind.
spell-snakes-swiftness: This spell functions as snake's swiftness, except as shown above.
spell-solipsism:
You manipulate the senses of the target creature so that it perceives itself to be the only real creature in all existence and everything around it is an illusion created by their mind or some nefarious outside force. If the target fails its save, it is convinced of the unreality of every situation it might encounter.

It takes no actions, not even purely mental actions, and instead watches the world around it with bemusement or frustration. The subject becomes effectively helpless and takes no steps to defend itself from any threat, since it considers any hostile action as unreal and any pain it may feel or damage suffered is fake. At the end of its turn, the target may make another saving throw to end the effect early.
spell-sound-lance:
You project a concentrated beam of sonic energy.

The sound deals 1d8 points of sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d8). A sound lance is ineffective in and cannot cross through an area of silence or a similar effect.
spell-spark-of-hope:
This spell imbues the target with a swelling sense of hope.

For the duration of the spell or until it is discharged, the target gets a +1 morale bonus on saves vs. fear and despair effects. On any other saving throw, attack roll skill check, the target may discharge the spell to gain a +1 morale bonus on that roll.
spell-speechlink:
You forge a connection between you and the target.

You and that target can communicate verbally as if you are adjacent regardless of distance or obstruction, as long as you both are on the same plane. Either participant may end the spell at any time. None of the other sounds around either participant is related to the other. For example, you can t hear the people in the booth over from your ally, but you can hear if they are relating their conversation. This spell works on any creature, regardless of Intelligence, though this spell does not confer any language comprehension or ability to speak.
spell-spell-conversion: This spell is only usable if you prepare your spells like a wizard or cleric. Upon completing this spell you can exchange one prepared spell for another you have available, via your spell list, spell book or familiar depending upon how you source your spells. The replacement spell must be the same level or lower than the one replaced. The new spell is then prepared and ready as if you had it prepared from the beginning. You may apply metamagic.
spell-spellcasting-mastery: Spellcasting Mastery You are quick and certain in your movements when casting spells. Prerequisite(s) Ability to cast spells or use spell-like abilities, Spellcraft 3 ranks. Benefit(s) You can take 10 on caster level checks (as though it were a skill check). This does not allow you to take 20 .
spell-staggering-melancholy: The target of the spell is struck with a profound sense of hopelessness. For the duration of the spell, the target is staggered and despairing. Each round at the beginning of their turn, a creature affected by this spell can attempt a new save. This is a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
spell-staggering-melancholy-mass: This spell acts as staggering melancholy except as noted above.
spell-stellar-storm:
Fiery plasma rains down from the stars into the area dealing 1d6 damage per level to all creatures and objects in the area (max 20d6).

The damage dealt is half fire damage and half electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

This spell is considered exposure to sunlight for creatures that fail their save and are affected by such effects.
spell-strangulation:
You focus your mind to manipulate the airways, arresting their organs that aid in the target's breathing, potentially choking the life out of them.

Each round you concentrate on this spell, it deals 3d8 bludgeoning damage and immobilizes the target. A creature immobilized in this way is unable to move and must hold its breath (see environmental hazards). The target creature may still attack, use abilities and cast spells (albeit impeded by the inability to breathe). Each round the spell affects the target, the target can attempt a Fortitude save to halve the damage and avoid being immobilized.
spell-supplicant: Supplicant You offer your service to a greater power to gain knowledge. Prerequisite(s) Ability to speak a language primarily spoken by outsiders (see below) or draconic. Benefit(s) You gain a +2 bonus on diplomacy checks with creatures who speak the primary language of the greater power you serve. Additionally, your liege grants you a special power based on the language you share. Abyssal You gain a +2 bonus on weapon damage rolls against creatures suffering from a fear effect. Aquan You gain a +4 bonus on Swim checks. Auran You gain a +2 bonus on saves against spells of the air and electricity descriptors. Celestial You gain a +2 bonus to saves against charm and fear effects. Draconic You gain a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks. Ignan Whenever you would deal fire damage, increase the amount of damage you deal by 2. Infernal Whenever a charm or compulsion effect originates from you or an item you carry, increase its save DC by 1. Terran You increase your natural armor bonus by +1. If you have no natural armor bonus you are granted a natural armor bonus of +1.
spell-symbol-of-despair:
This spell functions as symbol of death, except all creatures within 60 feet of a symbol of despair are struck with the despairing condition. Unlike symbol of death, symbol of despair has no hit point limit; once it is triggered, a symbol of despair remains active for 1 minute per caster level. If a creature leaves the area of the symbol they are no longer subject to its effects.

Symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell CL 11+ for the cost of 10,000 gp.
spell-symbol-of-despair-greater:
This spell functions as symbol of despair, except for the above and affected creatures are subject to the hopeless condition.

Greater symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell CL 15+ for the cost of 17,000 gp.
spell-symbol-of-despair-lesser:
This spell functions as symbol of despair, except for the above and affected creatures are subject to the doubting condition. Additionally the symbol remains active for 1 round per caster level.

Lesser symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell by a caster of 10th level or higher for the cost of 5,000 gp.
spell-tactical-precision: You create a bond of empathic understanding between the target creatures, allowing them insight into each other's actions. If two subjects of this spell flank the same creature, each gains a +2 insight bonus on their melee attack rolls against the flanked enemy and an extra 1d6 damage. The extra damage is considered precision damage.
spell-telepathic-bond-lesser:
You forge a telepathic bond with another creature with an Intelligence score of 6 or higher. The bond can be established only with a willing subject. You can communicate telepathically through the bond regardless of language. No special power, control or influence is established as a result of the bond.

Once the bond is formed, it works over any distance provided you and the target are on the same plane.
spell-tempest-of-shades:
You channel the forces of undeath and call forth an amalgam of vengeful dead slain by your enemies and allies. It manifests as a terrifying tornado os insubstantial howling faces. It occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a speed of 60 feet. It may move once on the turn it is summoned, but is unable to take any other actions.

The tempest arrives in an explosion of fell energy, all creatures within 60 feet must make a Fortitude save or gain 1d4 temporary negative levels. A successful save reduces this to 1 temporary negative level.

At the end of your next turn, the tempest of shades lets out a anguished scream. All enemies within 100 feet of the tempest must make Will saves or be panicked for 1 round, then frightened for 1d4 rounds thereafter. On a successful save, the creature is instead frightened for 1 round and shaken for 1d4 rounds thereafter.
spell-temple-of-the-gods:
You cause a temple to your deity or faith to phase into existence in an unoccupied area.

The temple is to the faith of the holy symbol used as a focus and it remains in the area for the duration of the spell or until dismissed.

You determine the characteristics of the temple's appearance, layout, lighting, sensory aspects and material composition. However, the enclosed interior only has 1 entry door.

When casting you designate who can open and close the door. While the temple appears as you chose, it is actually composed of force and extends to the ethereal plane.

You can determine up to 1 creature type per 4 caster levels that are not allowed to enter the temple. Such creatures are allowed a Will save upon attempting entry. If they fail, they are unable to cross the threshold or otherwise enter. On a success, they are able to enter the area but they take a -2 penalty to all attacks, ability checks, skill checks and saving throws.

The area within the temple negates any attempt at scrying within its walls. All conjuration (healing) spells cast within its confines are treated as though affected by the Empower Spell metamagic feat.

If you cast this spell on the same point every day for a year it becomes permanent. However, you can only have one instance of this spell active at a time. If you cast this spell while another casting is active, including a permanent one, the previous spell ends.
spell-though-crystal:
You cast this spell and focus your mind upon the mind of another. After 3 rounds of concentrating on this spell, a shard of crystal forcibly bursts from the target's head. The crystal deals 2d8 damage and 1d2 Intelligence damage and flies to your outstretched hand. If the spell is interrupted during the 3 rounds of concentration, it is lost.

Once you have received the crystal, you can use a full-round action to look into it and view the target's recent memories and surface thoughts. This acts as the spell detect thoughts regarding the surface thoughts and you can view memories of events the target was involved in within the last day. The crystal remains for 24 hours or until it has been viewed then disintegrates into a grayish powder.

If the target has had their memory modified or obliterated, this spell gets the modified version of events or the lack thereof. Only the caster can view the contents of the crystal.
spell-touch-of-despair:
This spell imbues the target with a sense of impending loss and sadness.

For the duration of the spell or until it is discharged, the target takes a -1 penalty on saves vs. fear and despair effects. As an immediate action the cast of this spell can discharge it to impose a -1 penalty on the target's next attack, ability or skill check, saving throw, or damage roll.
spell-true-casting: Your next single spell (if it is cast before the end of the next round) gains a +10 insight bonus on any caster level checks to overcome spell resistance or cast defensively.
spell-true-casting-3pp-rite-publishing: You gain temporary, intuitive insight into the immediate future that assists with your spell casting against a singular opponent. Your next spell that targets a single creature (if it is made before the end of the next round) gains a +1 insight bonus to the save DC. If that creature successfully saves, your next spell that targets that same creature and only that creature (if it is made before the end of the following round) gains a +2 insight bonus to the save DC. This process continues until your insight bonus reaches its maximum of +5, you fail to cast a spell targeting the same singular creature in each following round, or the target creature fails a saving throw.
spell-undermine-reality: You shunt part of the target creature into the plane of shadow causing them to straddle the planar line between that plane and the one you are on. The target must make a Will save or become quasi-real. While in this state all attacks and spells deal half damage and all spells and effects that require a saving throw get a Will saving throw to negate them before rolling the save for the spell. On each one of its turns, the target may attempt another Will save as a move action to end this effect. A successful initial save reduces the duration to 1 round and a successful subsequent save ends the effect at the end of its current turn.
spell-utter-disappointment: The next time the subject of this spell attempts an action that requires a die roll to determine the outcome, that action fails unless they succeed at a Will save. However, the spell creates the image in the subject's mind that it succeeded. The subject behaves accordingly for 1 round. At the end of that round the image fades from the target's mind and they must make an additional Will save, failure means they take a -4 penalty on their next attack roll, saving throw, or skill check that occurs within 10 minutes.
spell-vortex-warp:
You commune with the spirits of nature and call upon them to aid you against your foes.

You cause an area you can see within range to become animated, the flora and terrain attacks and thwarts your foes until the spell ends.
spell-warning: When you cast this spell you gain a +3 bonus to Perception checks as you gain a preternatural sense of imminent danger. In addition you also gain Uncanny Dodge as the Rogue class feature of the same name.
spell-wave-of-pain: All living creatures within the cone are overcome with intense pain. They are stunned for the duration of the spell unless they succeed at a Fortitude save. Creatures with resistance or immunity against precision damage and critical hits or has been healed in the round prior to the saving throw gains a +4 bonus on the save against this spell. Each round, at the end of its turns, a subject of the spell can attempt a new save to end the effect.
spell-whispers-of-civilization: You commune with the surrounding settlement to gain information about recent goings-on. You learn information about the settlement you are in as though you had rolled a Knowledge (local) check with a result of 25. In addition you may roll a Survival check or a Knowledge (geography) check with a DC of 20, if you succeed you commit a rough map of the settlement to your memory. This includes the location of important landmarks and administrative buildings as well as local gathering spots such as a pub or church. You may also ask a single question of the settlement, the animus summoned does not deceive or trick but may offer only vague information as it has no regard for personal details. But it does have regard for details that are related to commerce and construction. For example, you may ask if a specific merchant by name passed through the town and the answer could be as straightforward as many merchants have passed through recently. But if you describe the merchant's wagon and wares and ask with whom such a merchant did business you may get a more helpful answer.
spell-winters-breath: You breathe out a 15-foot cone of freezing frost. You deal 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) to every creature within the area. In addition to the cold damage, they are also staggered for 1 round.
spell-wise-council:
Your words hold more weight and are delivered in a more believable fashion.

You gain a +20 on Diplomacy checks made to alleviate despair (See New Skill Uses), convince others to restrain hostilities via Make a Request, or to improve attitude above hostile or unfriendly. This does not provide a bonus toward improving any attitude above unfriendly, gathering information, making other requests, suggesting courses of action or bartering.
spell-wolf-call: You let out a howl of a wolf to summon nearby wolves to your side. You summon 1 wolf per caster level. Alternatively you can exchange 5 wolves for 1 dire wolf or 1 wolf swarm. The wolf swarm uses a dire wolf's statistics but it gains the swarm subtype and a swarm attack that deals 3d6 damage, and the distraction special attack (DC 15). Whenever the pack damages an opponent with its swarm attack, it can immediately attempt a trip combat maneuver check against that creature with its trip special attack. The pack does not gain any damage reduction or immunity to damage and can be attacked by effects that target a specific number of creatures, though such attacks deal 1/4 the normal amount of damage (25%) and effects that don't deal hit point damage are only 25% likely to work.
spell-wounds-transference: If you are currently wounded, you may transfer your wounds to a living creature you touch. The target takes damage equal 1 point per caster level to a maximum of your unhealed total hit point damage. You are healed by the same amount of damage.
spell-wrath-of-nature: You twist reality around a target creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Fortitude saving throw, for which they can choose to fail, or be teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The chosen space must be on a space or in a liquid that can support the target without causing squeezing or damaging the target.
spell-zone-of-revelation:
All creatures and objects within the area of the zone of revelation are made visible. This includes not only those that are invisible but also those that are traveling on adjacent planes like the ethereal plane or plane of shadow. The effects are not dispelled, nor are they able to be targeted if they are on a different plane, they simply become visible.

Additionally, this spell suppressed spells like blur, displacement or mirror image. The suppressed spells resume if the creatures leave the effect radius.
spell-energy-charge: The spell captures some of the energy directed at you, lessening it and storing it for your next melee attack. You gain energy resistance 5 against a chosen damage type until the end of your next turn. The energy type must be chosen at the time of casting and does not change for the duration of the spell. You cannot have multiple iterations of this spell active at one time. If you are damaged by the selected damage type during the spell's duration, you may discharge this spell by making an enhanced melee attack as part of your normal attacks, including attacks of opportunity, made in the round. You must declare the discharge before the attack is made and if the attack misses, the extra energy damage is lost. The energy discharge attack, if successful, adds 1d6 of that energy damage to your attack. The discharge only affects one attack in the round regardless of the number of attacks you may have. This discharge may be used on attacks of opportunity.
spell-fire-bolt-greater: This spell functions like fire bolt except the bolt deals 1d6 damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels (max 5d6). The bolt will ignite flammable substances it hits.
spell-force-ward: You create a minor force barrier around yourself. Until the end of your next turn, you gain DR 1/-.
spell-hellfire-rebuke: You pull fire from the hells to strike any who would deign to attack you. When activated, the creature that attacked you is dealt 1d4 damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Half of the damage dealt is fire damage and the other half is hellish damage and is not subject to energy resistance or immunity.
spell-hungry-void: You invoke fell words and a small rift in reality opens to the void beyond the stars. The area has its light lowered by 1 level and the area is considered difficult terrain. Any creature entering or beginning their turn in the dark rift takes 1d6 cold damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d6). A successful Fortitude save halves this damage. Any creature moving more than 10 feet within the spell area or ending their turn in the area are touched by otherworldly appendages and take 1d6 acid damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d6). A successful Reflex save halves this damage. A creature is only damaged by the appendages once per turn even if they move more than 10 feet in the spell area and/or end their turn within.
spell-mantle-of-goodness: You radiate a holy power out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional power to combat evil. While in the aura's radius your allies deal 1d6 extra damage on melee or ranged attacks against evil-aligned foes. If the target is undead or an evil outsider, the damage is increased to 1d8.
spell-mantle-of-vileness: You radiate an unholy power out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional power to combat the lackeys of good. While in the aura's radius your allies deal 1d6 extra damage on melee or ranged attacks against good-aligned foes. If the target is a good outsider, the damage is increased to 1d8.
spell-mocking-jibe: You unleash magically-enhanced insults and verbal jabs at a target in range. If the target can hear you, they must make a Will save or be dealt 1d4 damage and take a -1 penalty on attack rolls and concentration checks until your next turn. A successful save halves the damage and negates the penalty.
spell-moonlight:
You create a column of silvery moonlight in a 5-foot-radius in a 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time or if they begin their turn in the area, they are immolated by ghostly energy.

The creature must make a Fortitude save or be dealt 3d4 damage and be subject to any effects triggered by moonlight. A successful save halves the damage and does not trigger any moonlight effects.

You may, as a move action, direct the moonlight to move up to 30 feet per round.

The shaft of moonlight winks out of existence if it is moved out of the spell's range. The area in the cylinder is considered dim light. A spell that creates darkness of 3rd-level or higher negates the effects of this spell within the radius of its darkness effect but does not dispel the moonlight spell.
spell-naturecraft: By channeling your connection to nature, you can create one of the following effects:
spell-sanctify-grove:
You commune with nature and channel its power to sanctify a natural area with your power. The area can be as small as a 30-footradius and as large as a 90-foot-radius. Any buildings or other manufactured areas are excluded from the effect. You can create the following effects:

You are immune to these effects and you may designate allies to be unaffected by the spell or a pass phrase to bypass it. Those you succeed on their save, or are otherwise immune to the effect, see more benign versions of the effects, like beautiful plant growth, a cooling mist, a fragrant breeze, etc.
spell-shroud-of-caustic-mist: This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling acidic mist around the target and the spell deals acid damage instead of cold damage.
spell-shroud-of-charged-filings: This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling cloud of charged copper around the target and the spell deals electricity damage instead of cold damage.
spell-shroud-of-fiery-ash: This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling cloud of burning ash around the target and the spell deals fire damage instead of cold damage.
spell-shroud-of-icy-mist: You create a swirling cold mist around the target granting them temporary hit points equal to 1d8+1/per caster level (max +5). Any adjacent creature that attacks the affected target or any creature attacking the target with a melee natural attack is dealt cold damage equal to the temporary hp from this spell that are lost.
spell-sonic-burst: You explode in a concussive force that deals 1d4 sonic damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Additionally, on a failed save, each creature is pushed back 5 feet. If the save is failed by 5 or more, they are pushed back 10 feet instead.
spell-thaumaturgy: You may manifest some power to show some sign of supernatural power. You can create one of the following effects within the range:
spell-vinestrike:
You transmute a bit of thorned plant matter into a long thorned whip. You make a standard melee attack roll at one creature within range.

This attack roll may be affected by Weapon Finesse if applicable. On a hit, you deal 1d6 piercing damage to the target and attempt to pull it toward you. You make a reposition combat maneuver against the target and add your Wisdom bonus to the attempt. If the check is successful, you may only pull the target toward you.
spell-void-eruption:
You invoke dark speech and dark tentacles from beyond the stars erupt from you striking all creatures within 10 feet. These tentacles deal 1d6 damage plus an additional 1d6 damage every two levels thereafter (maximum 5d6) and the subjects are staggered for 1 round. The damage dealt is half acid and half cold damage.

On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not staggered.
spell-volatile-blast:
You launch a small bead of energy that flares at one moment and crackles with frost at another. The bead of energy explodes dealing 1d8 plus 1d6 damage per caster level after the first (maximum 9d6) to every creature in the area. The damage dealt by the spell is random.

Roll a d8 and consult the table under the volatile bolt spell.

Like the volatile bolt spell, you may choose the damage type by using the result of the d8 damage die or the d8 rolled for the table. If both results are the same, the radius of the burst is increased by 10 feet.
